$comment: Every label the issue templates and workflows use. sync-labels.yml creates missing ones and fixes colours / descriptions; it never deletes or renames a label. validate_github_forms.py checks templates and issue-triage.json against this list.

labels.name: BUG
labels.description: Something isn't working

labels.name: CRASH
labels.description: Crash, freeze, hang or GPU device lost

labels.name: DATA LOSS
labels.description: A project, airport or scenery file was lost or damaged

labels.name: REGRESSION
labels.description: Worked in an earlier version

labels.name: PERFORMANCE
labels.description: Slow frames, slow loading or high memory use

labels.name: XP12 PARITY
labels.description: The viewport doesn't match X-Plane 12

labels.name: FILE FORMAT
labels.description: Files read, saved or exported wrong, or rejected by X-Plane / WorldEditor

labels.name: FEATURE REQUEST
labels.description: New feature or request

labels.name: FEATURE
labels.description: Feature to be added.

labels.name: TODO TASK
labels.description: Scoped development task

labels.name: AGENT TASK
labels.description: Written so an AI coding agent can pick it up

labels.name: DOCUMENTATION
labels.description: Improvements or additions to documentation

labels.name: CORE
labels.description: Core item/ feature for the program

labels.name: UI
labels.description: Issue associated with UI element

labels.name: Viewport
labels.description: Issue associated with 3D Viewport

labels.name: GRAPHICS ENGINE
labels.description: Issue associated with Vulkan Graphics Engine

labels.name: AIRPORTS
labels.description: apt.dat airports and the AIRPORTS panel

labels.name: PROJECTS
labels.description: .edX / .sex projects, saving, recovery, WorldEditor import / export

labels.name: SCENERY EXPORT
labels.description: Scenery pack export: DSF, apt.dat, scenery_packs.ini

labels.name: X-PLANE ASSETS
labels.description: Library scan, objects, facades, forests, autogen, thumbnails

labels.name: TERRAIN
labels.description: Roads, base terrain and water

labels.name: GATEWAY
labels.description: X-Plane Scenery Gateway download, validation and upload

labels.name: BUILD
labels.description: Build system, CI, tests, installer and packaging

labels.name: WINDOWS
labels.description: Happens on Windows

labels.name: LINUX
labels.description: Happens on Linux

labels.name: MACOS
labels.description: Happens on macOS

labels.name: NEEDS TRIAGE
labels.description: New: not looked at by a maintainer yet

labels.name: FEEDBACK
labels.description: Further information is requested.

labels.name: BACKLOG
labels.description: Added to backlog for future implementation or fix.

labels.name: DUPLICATE ISSUE
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: This will not be worked on

labels.name: CLAUDE
labels.description: Claude works on this issue and pushes a branch (claude.yml)

labels.name: CLAUDE TRIAGE
labels.description: Claude investigates and posts a triage report without changing code

labels.name: RELEASE
labels.description: Project release

labels.name: BETA
labels.description: Beta version release

labels.name: PATCH
labels.description: Project patch release
